title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B
variant: NVIDIA 24GB checkpoint, fp8 KV, DFlash drafter
summary: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B (24GB) on one 32 GB RTX 5090 with a digest-pinned vLLM v0.34.0 image (bundled b12x and FlashInfer kernels, nothing installed at boot) and three .env profiles: fast, long and multi.

configs.label: fast
configs.notes: DFlash LiLiCorr drafter, 5 tokens, GPU mem util 0.95, max_num_batched_tokens 4096. Power limit 408 W, stock clocks, fp8 KV, warm runs. Decode is about 218 tok/s: medians of 8 runs on 3 boots were 226, 213, 217. Originally measured on vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-77154ca6 with b12x; re-confirmation on pinned vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0 pending RTX 5090 hardware access.

configs.label: long
configs.notes: No drafter, GPU mem util 0.96, max_num_batched_tokens 4096. Power limit 408 W, stock clocks, fp8 KV, warm runs. 196K prefill 4,460-4,490 tok/s. Originally measured on vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-77154ca6 with b12x; re-confirmation on pinned vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0 pending RTX 5090 hardware access.

configs.label: multi
configs.notes: No drafter, 8 sequences, GPU mem util 0.88 with VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS=0. Power limit 408 W, stock clocks, fp8 KV, warm runs, 512-token decode, all requests started at once. The 4-request figures were measured with 4 sequences; with 8 sequences 4 requests give 429-434 tok/s total. Originally measured on vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-77154ca6 with b12x; re-confirmation on pinned vllm/vllm-openai:v0.34.0 pending RTX 5090 hardware access.
